content_sections.heading: CWSSU Meghalaya Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details (Department-wise)
content_sections.text: 18 Departments 85 Assistant Professor Posts 149 Total Posts

content_sections.heading: CWSSU Meghalaya Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: An eminent scholar with a Ph.D. degree in the concerned subject and actively engaged in research. A minimum of 10 research publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals, and a total Research Score of 120, as per the criteria in Appendix II Table 2 of UGC Regulations, 2018. A minimum of 10 years’ teaching experience in a university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, or equivalent research experience at an equivalent level. OR an outstanding professional with a Ph.D. in the concerned subject from any academic institution/industry, who has made a significant contribution to knowledge. A good academic record with a Ph.D. degree in the concerned subject. A Master’s degree with at least 55% marks (or equivalent grade point scale) in the concerned subject. A minimum of 8 years’ experience in teaching or research in an academic/research post equivalent to that of Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research institution. A minimum of 7 publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals, and a total Research Score of 75, as per the criteria in Appendix II Table 2 of UGC Regulations, 2018. Academic Qualification: Master’s degree with at least 55% marks (or equivalent grade point scale) in the concerned subject, from an Indian University or an accredited foreign University. Relaxation of 5% (from 55% to 50%) is applicable for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates. Eligibility Test: The candidate must have cleared NET/CSIR-NET conducted by UGC-CSIR, or SET-NE, in the concerned subject. Exemption from NET/SLET/SET: Candidates awarded a Ph.D. degree in accordance with UGC Regulations 2009/2016 (and amendments) are exempted. Reservation of Vacancies: As per the existing Reservation Policy and Guidelines of the Government of Meghalaya, as amended from time to time.

content_sections.heading: CWSSU Meghalaya Recruitment 2026 Pay Scale
content_sections.text: Pay levels are as per the State University Pay Scales; Dearness Allowance (DA) and other allowances are payable as per Government of Meghalaya rates.

content_sections.heading: CWSSU Meghalaya Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection comprises two stages: (i) Shortlisting of candidates, and (ii) Personal Interview, with final selection made per the provisions below. Academic score is considered for shortlisting candidates for interview only – the final selection is based solely on interview performance. Assistant Professor: Shortlisting is based on academic score as per Appendix II Table 3A of UGC Regulations, 2018. Associate Professor & Professor: Shortlisting is based on verification of minimum eligibility, API Research Score verification, and evaluation of publications as per Appendix II Table 2 of UGC Regulations, 2018. Candidates are called for Personal Interview in the ratio of 1:3 for Assistant Professor, 1:5 for Associate Professor, and 1:5 for Professor , relative to the number of vacancies, based on shortlisting scores. Final selection is based entirely on performance in the Personal Interview. Only candidates who have produced all required documents in original relating to their educational qualification, date of birth, caste, community, and other certificates wherever required and prescribed by Rules will be deemed qualified to be called for Personal Interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CWSSU Meghalaya Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Ensure you possess the requisite educational qualification in the concerned subject(s) prescribed for the post, on or before the last date fixed for submission of applications. Visit the online recruitment portal at rpa.meghalaya.gov.in/cwssu (the link is also available on the University website). First create and complete your profile on the portal, furnishing details of your education qualification, work experience, publications, and other relevant information. Apply for the advertised post(s) through the portal, and pay the application fee exclusively through the portal. Submit your application before 11 October 2026, midnight . Important: Applications are accepted only through the online recruitment portal. No application submitted through email, post, courier, or any other mode will be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Educational qualification certificates (Master’s degree, Ph.D., etc., as applicable) and mark sheets NET/CSIR-NET/SET-NE certificate, for Assistant Professor applicants not exempted via Ph.D. Proof of Date of Birth Caste/Community certificate (Scheduled Tribe/Scheduled Caste, etc.), in the prescribed format issued by the appropriate authority, where applicable Proof of teaching/research experience, as applicable to the post Documentation supporting the claimed Research Score/API Score and publication record (Professor and Associate Professor applicants), as per Appendix II Table 2 of UGC Regulations, 2018 No Objection Certificate (NOC) from current employer, for candidates already in service (to be produced at the time of interview) Any other certificate required and prescribed by the applicable Rules

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Application Fee: Rs. 1000/- for General candidates; Rs. 500/- for ST/SC/OBC candidates. Payable exclusively through the recruitment portal; once paid, the fee is not refunded under any circumstances. Applicants are advised to submit well before the closing date to avoid last-minute technical difficulties. Incomplete applications, and applications not supported by the requisite documents, will be summarily rejected. If at any stage a candidate is found to have furnished false, incorrect, or misleading information, or to have suppressed any material fact, their candidature is liable to be cancelled and, if appointed, the appointment is liable to be terminated without notice. ST/SC certificates must be in the prescribed format, issued by the appropriate authority. Candidates already in service must apply through the online portal and produce a No Objection Certificate from their employer at the time of interview, failing which they will not be considered for appointment. The decision of the Selection Committee is final and binding on all candidates. No TA/DA will be provided to candidates attending the interview. Appointment against any advertised vacancy is subject to verification of credentials, fulfilment of eligibility conditions, and approval of the Competent Authority. For recruitment-related queries only (not for submitting applications or documents), candidates may contact the University at [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. How many teaching posts has CWSSU advertised?
faq.answer: 149 posts – 18 Professor, 46 Associate Professor, and 85 Assistant Professor – across 18 departments for the Tura and Shillong campuses.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The recruitment portal closes at midnight on 11 October 2026; it opened on 22 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: A Master’s degree with at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/OBC-NCL) in the concerned subject, plus a cleared NET/CSIR-NET/SET-NE, unless exempted by holding a Ph.D. under UGC Regulations 2009/2016.

faq.question: Q4. Is there a written exam?
faq.answer: No. Selection is through shortlisting (based on academic/research score) followed by a Personal Interview; final selection is based entirely on interview performance.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale?
faq.answer: Basic Pay of Rs. 57,700 for Assistant Professor, Rs. 1,31,400 for Associate Professor, and Rs. 1,44,200 for Professor, plus DA and other allowances per Government of Meghalaya rates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: Rs. 1000/- for General candidates and Rs. 500/- for ST/SC/OBC candidates, paid only through the recruitment portal; it is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. In what ratio are candidates called for interview?
faq.answer: 1:3 for Assistant Professor, and 1:5 for both Associate Professor and Professor, relative to the number of vacancies, based on shortlisting scores.

faq.question: Q8. Where do I apply?
faq.answer: Only online, through rpa.meghalaya.gov.in/cwssu; applications via email, post, or courier are not accepted.
